page.notes: Old-German and Gothic-style names are set in italic and black letter; reproduced as closely as legible. Several words in the first lines are uncertain due to the faded scan, notably the italic surnames (e.g. "Goldi", "Gutlickon", "Kienast"). The right-hand foot shows partial catchword "Alt." and the signature "Cc 2".
